svg.title: Amylose and amylopectin: the two links
svg.desc: Skeletal formulas of maltose and isomaltose showing the alpha-1,4 and alpha-1,6 glycosidic links, above schematic drawings of a linear amylose chain and a branched amylopectin molecule.
svg.text: the chain link · PubChem CID 439186 · C12H22O11
the branch link · PubChem CID 439193 · C12H22O11
mostly α-1,4 links, a few long branches
α-1,4 chains joined by α-1,6 branch points
Schematic: each dot is one glucose unit. Not to scale: amylopectin molecules are about 100 times heavier than amylose.
